text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One afternoon, while I'm taking a break
at the
racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So a younger Umamusume came up to
me very
seriously and asked me for some
advice on how to
run faster.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
It would've been easy-peasy,
lemon-squeezy if all she wanted was an
instinct-based approach, but
she
actually wanted logic-based information.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But I'm not a trainer... I get the feeling
that giving that sort of advice would be
pretty bogus, ya
know? Like that's mad
irresponsible.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
But since she mustered up the courage
to ask for
my advice, I want to help her
the best I can.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I figured I'd ask you what
kinda advice
you would've given her
since you're a pro and all.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, I dig! So it's all in the knees! ♪
choice_data_list: Teach how to use the knees.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right. How you use the power in
your
knees is really important, especially
in the
beginning!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Wicked. It's all coming to me now. Now
that's the
bomb-dot-com! Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky spends the rest of the day 
passionately teaching the younger
Umamusume
on the other side of the
track.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're right. It all boils down to how
much energy
she's got in the first place.
That might be where
her problem lies.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I think I can give her some good
advice
now! Rock on! Thanks! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky spends the rest of the day
helping
the younger Umamusume train
on the other side
of the track.
